scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/tma && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/landing/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=apps/api && npm test --workspace=apps/tma && npm test --workspace=apps/landing
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/tma && npm run build --workspace=apps/admin && npm run build --workspace=apps/landing
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:env && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:down: npm run docker:env && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.docker:reset: npm run docker:env && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && npm run docker:up
scripts.docker:logs: npm run docker:env && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f --tail=100
scripts.docker:ps: npm run docker:env && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.dev.yml ps
